"""Frozen correctness-only activation check: 42 cells, 126 calls, no retries.

Each cell runs the qualified hidden plugin once and activated public plugin twice
on the same host. No timing verdict or additional qualification samples.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import socket
import sys
import time

if not __debug__:
    raise RuntimeError('verification requires enabled Python assertions')

task=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
system=platform.system()
repo=task.parents[2] if system=='Darwin' else task/'sources/gates-activation'
sys.path[:0]=[str(repo/'scripts'),str(repo/'bench')]
import qualify as q
import routing
import two_fe_policy_development as gates

started=time.monotonic()
assert system in ('Darwin','Linux')
assert len(sys.argv)==2 and len(sys.argv[1])==64, 'pass the frozen activation configuration hash'
config_path=task/'policy-gates'/f'activation-{system}.json'
assert q.digest(config_path)==sys.argv[1]
config=q.read(config_path)
assert q.digest(Path(__file__))==config['driver_sha256']
assert config['call_cap']==126 and config['budget_s']==1800 and config['per_call_s']==120
plan_path=task/'policy-gates'/('qualification-plan-Darwin.json' if system=='Darwin' else 'qualification-plan-Linux-mpi.json')
plan=q.read(plan_path)
assert q.digest(plan_path)==config['qualification_plan_sha256']
assert len(plan['cases'])==21 and plan['threads']==[1,4]
hidden=task/'artifacts'/system/'policy-gates.plugin'
public=task/'artifacts'/system/'gates-public.plugin'
harness=q.resolve(plan_path,plan['harness'])
assert q.digest(hidden)==config['hidden_sha256']
assert config['hidden_sha256']==plan['files'][plan['artifacts']['candidate']['path']]
assert plan['artifacts']['candidate']['request']==routing.GATES
assert plan['artifacts']['candidate']['revision']=='e9be9e64e4c0d3bed2de5434e756246eee9296c1'
assert q.digest(public)==config['public_sha256']
assert q.digest(harness)==plan['files'][plan['harness']]
assert config['execution_sources']=={n:q.digest(p) for n,p in q.execution_sources().items()}
identities={str(p):q.digest(p) for p in [config_path,plan_path,hidden,public,harness,Path(__file__)]}
for name,digest in plan['files'].items():
    path=q.resolve(plan_path,name)
    assert q.digest(path)==digest,name
    identities[str(path)]=digest
for name,path in q.execution_sources().items():identities[str(path)]=config['execution_sources'][name]
qualified_cells={}
assert (system=='Darwin' and config['qualified_reference'] is not None) or (
    system=='Linux' and config['qualified_reference'] is None
    and config['fresh_same_host_hidden_schedule'] is True)
if config['qualified_reference'] is not None:
    reference_path=task/config['qualified_reference']['path']
    assert q.digest(reference_path)==config['qualified_reference']['sha256']
    reference=q.read(reference_path)
    assert reference['status']=='complete' and not reference['failures']
    assert reference['platform']==system and reference['manifest_sha256']==routing.identity(plan)
    assert q.physical_host(reference['hostname'],True)==q.physical_host(socket.gethostname(),True)
    qualified_cells={c['id']:c for c in reference['cases']}
    assert len(qualified_cells)==42
    identities[str(reference_path)]=config['qualified_reference']['sha256']
stamps={name:q.stamp(Path(name)) for name in identities}
output=task/'policy-gates'/f'activation-{system}'
output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
record=dict(schema=1,status='running',platform=system,hostname=socket.gethostname(),
    call_cap=126,per_call_timeout_s=120,total_budget_s=1800,native_calls=0,
    purpose='Exact public-versus-qualified-hidden correctness, fixed-worker repeats, cross-worker science and discrete decisions; no timing verdict.',
    identities=identities,config=config,calls=[],cells=[],failures=[])
def save():q.write(output/'summary.json',record)
def unchanged():assert all(q.stamp(Path(n))==s for n,s in stamps.items()), 'bound evidence changed'
def resource_view(detail):
    return {k:([{n:v for n,v in action.items() if n!='memory_bytes_limit'} for action in value]
               if k=='action_resources' else value) for k,value in detail.items()}
save()
first={}
try:
    with q.Deadline(1800,started) as deadline:
        for item in plan['cases']:
            meta=q.metadata(plan,item,plan_path)
            policy=q.resource_policy(plan,'candidate',meta)
            for workers in [1,4]:
                cell=f"{item['id']}-t{workers}";folder=output/cell;folder.mkdir()
                snapshots={};calls={}
                for role,artifact in [('hidden',hidden),('public',public),('repeat',public)]:
                    unchanged();deadline.check();assert record['native_calls']<126
                    request=folder/(role+'.case')
                    routing.prepare(q.resolve(plan_path,item['input']),request,routing.GATES if role=='hidden' else 'baseline',workers)
                    target=folder/(role+'.json');log=folder/(role+'.log')
                    env=['env',*[v for key in q.ENVIRONMENT for v in ('-u',key)],*[key+'=1' for key in q.THREAD_ENV], 'FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE=1']
                    if item['memory_limit_bytes'] is not None:env+=['FEREG_MEMORY_LIMIT_BYTES='+str(item['memory_limit_bytes'])]
                    call=dict(cell=cell,role=role,input_sha256=q.digest(request),status='started')
                    record['calls'].append(call);record['native_calls']+=1;save()
                    q.run_process([*env,str(harness),str(artifact),'--replay',str(request),str(target)],log,min(120,deadline.check()))
                    raw,columns,detail=q.read_native(target,log,meta)
                    resources=q.science.resource_diagnostics(log.read_text(),policy,False,{},
                        expected_preset=routing.policy(policy)['injection'] if policy else None)
                    resources['gate_events']=gates.gate_events(log.read_text())
                    call.update(log_sha256=q.digest(log),result_sha256=q.digest(target),columns_sha256=q.digest(columns),
                        fingerprint=detail['fingerprint'],worker_signature=q.worker_signature(raw),
                        resource=resources,policy_signature=gates.semantic_signature(resources),
                        native_seconds=detail['seconds'],oracle='passed')
                    deadline.check();call['status']='passed';snapshots[role]=(raw,columns,detail);calls[role]=call;save()
                for role in ['public','repeat']:
                    assert calls[role]['fingerprint']==calls['hidden']['fingerprint'], 'exact public/hidden science changed'
                    assert calls[role]['worker_signature']==calls['hidden']['worker_signature'], 'public/hidden discrete signature'
                    assert resource_view(calls[role]['resource'])==resource_view(calls['hidden']['resource']), 'public/hidden resource/gate/hierarchy changed'
                if qualified_cells:
                    retained=qualified_cells[cell]
                    warm=next(c for c in retained['warmups'] if c['execution']=='candidate')
                    assert calls['hidden']['fingerprint']==warm['fingerprint'], 'same-host qualified hidden reference changed'
                    assert calls['hidden']['worker_signature']==retained['worker_signatures']['candidate']
                public_base=folder/'public-saved'
                q.retained_snapshot(public_base,*snapshots['public'][:2],meta)
                if workers==4:
                    old,old_call=first[item['id']]
                    q.compare_saved(old,public_base,meta)
                    assert old_call['worker_signature']==calls['public']['worker_signature'], 'cross-worker discrete signature'
                    assert old_call['policy_signature']==calls['public']['policy_signature'], 'cross-worker gate/hierarchy'
                else:first[item['id']]=(public_base,calls['public'])
                record['cells'].append(dict(id=cell,exact_public_hidden=True,repeat=True,independent_oracles=3,
                    cross_worker='passed' if workers==4 else 'reference',
                    retained_outputs_sha256=q.digest(public_base.with_suffix('.npz'))))
                save();print(cell,'PASS',flush=True)
                for role in ['hidden','public','repeat']:
                    (folder/(role+'.case')).unlink()
                    snapshots[role][1].unlink()
        assert record['native_calls']==126 and len(record['cells'])==42
        unchanged();deadline.check();record.update(status='passed',elapsed_s=time.monotonic()-started);save();deadline.check()
except BaseException as error:
    record.update(status='failed',elapsed_s=time.monotonic()-started)
    record['failures'].append(dict(type=type(error).__name__,message=str(error)));save();raise
print('GATES_PUBLIC_HIDDEN_EXACT_COMPLETE 126',flush=True)

independent_verifier.source:
"""Bounded local audit of the two fixed activation correctness schedules.

Zero native calls, no performance verdict, no retries. The 84 retained public
NPZ banks are reconstructed independently; deleted hidden/repeat columns are
bound by their original online full-column hashes, not claimed as reread here.
Run: python verify-gates-public-evidence.py FROZEN_HELPER_SHA256
"""
import ast
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import ipaddress
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import re
import signal
import sys
import tempfile
import time

TASK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WORK = TASK / 'policy-gates'
REPO = TASK.parents[2]
REMOTE = '<scc-task>'
OUTPUT = WORK / 'activation-independent-review.json'
RECONSTRUCTION_SHA = 'af70bd42911657749507c5f7776cf10d5abcb43c960a5cf4c831cfd46f963f1b'


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def identity(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()


def clean(value):
    if isinstance(value, str):
        value = value.replace(str(TASK), '<task>').replace(REMOTE, '<task>').replace(str(REPO), '<repository>')
        value = value.replace('target/' + 'tmp/', '<target-tmp>/')
        value = re.sub(r'/(?:Users|usr2/faculty|usr4/econ)/[^/\s]+', '<user-home>', value)
        def private_ip(match):
            try:
                return '<private-ip>' if ipaddress.ip_address(match[0]).is_private else match[0]
            except ValueError:
                return match[0]
        return re.sub(r'(?<![0-9])(?:[0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}(?![0-9])', private_ip, value)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [clean(x) for x in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {clean(k): clean(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value


def main():
    require(len(sys.argv) == 2 and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', sys.argv[1]), 'pass frozen verifier SHA256')
    require(sha(__file__) == sys.argv[1], 'verifier differs from frozen source')
    require(not OUTPUT.exists(), 'refuse to overwrite an independent review')
    start = time.monotonic()
    counts = Counter()
    bindings, stamps, platforms = {}, {}, {}
    result = dict(schema=1, status='running', native_calls_started=0, analysis_budget_s=600,
                  verifier_sha256=sys.argv[1], errors=[], counts={},
                  limits=[
                      'No native execution, timing verdict, sampling, retry, or model fitting.',
                      '84 actual public NPZ banks are reread and reconstructed. Deleted hidden/repeat full columns are attested by their retained online hashes and the bound driver; they are not independently reread.',
                      'Scientific witnesses reuse maintained independent mathematics; this verifier is not a second oracle implementation.',
                      'Fixed-W hidden/public/repeat science, accounted resources and policy are exact. Each observed memory limit is checked individually; host census values, RSS and timers are not equality targets.',
                      'Cross-worker science/discrete policy is checked within each platform. No cross-platform bit-equality requirement.',
                      'Both earlier source-suite failures are retained separately from successful native schedules. This record alone does not assert all native ABI/Stata/rollback release prerequisites.'])
    def timeout(*_):
        raise TimeoutError('fixed activation evidence analysis budget exhausted')
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, timeout)
    signal.alarm(600)
    try:
        source_root = TASK / 'sources/gates-activation'
        sys.path[:0] = [str(source_root / 'bench'), str(source_root / 'scripts')]
        import numpy as np
        import qualify as q
        import routing
        import two_fe_policy_development as gates

        def verify(path, expected=None):
            path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
            before = q.stamp(path)
            if path not in bindings:
                bindings[path] = sha(path)
                stamps[path] = before
            require(q.stamp(path) == stamps[path], 'bound file changed: ' + path.name)
            require(expected is None or bindings[path] == expected, 'file hash mismatch: ' + path.name)
            return bindings[path]

        def read(path, expected=None):
            verify(path, expected)
            return q.read(path)

        def local_path(name):
            name = str(name)
            if name.startswith(REMOTE + '/'):
                return TASK / name[len(REMOTE) + 1:]
            path = Path(name)
            require(path.is_absolute() and (path.is_relative_to(TASK) or path.is_relative_to(REPO)),
                    'unrecognized evidence identity path')
            return path

        freeze_path = REPO / 'bench/results/two-fe-policy-gates-activation-freeze-20261022.json'
        freeze = read(freeze_path)
        require(freeze['independent_verifier']['sha256'] == sys.argv[1], 'verifier differs from activation freeze')
        source = read(TASK / 'gates-activation-source.json')
        require(clean(source) == freeze['public_source'], 'source manifest differs from committed activation freeze')
        require(source['cmg'] == 'fd77d98da1f74009b3e5b634e1944433b647a9b1', 'CMG pin changed')
        verify(TASK / 'gates-activation-source.tar', source['archive_sha256'])
        for relative, digest in source['source_files_sha256'].items():
            path = (source_root / relative).resolve()
            require(path.is_relative_to(source_root.resolve()), 'source manifest escapes archive')
            verify(path, digest)
        for name, digest in source['build_wrappers'].items():
            verify(TASK / name, digest)
        verify(TASK / 'check-gates-public.py', freeze['driver']['sha256'])
        execution = {name: verify(path) for name, path in q.execution_sources().items()}
        original = TASK / 'verify-gates-qualification-linux.py'
        verify(original, RECONSTRUCTION_SHA)
        nodes = [node for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(original.read_text()))
                 if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in {'require', 'identity', 'original_bank', 'reconstruct'}]
        require(len(nodes) == 4 and len({node.name for node in nodes}) == 4, 'ambiguous reconstruction functions')
        reconstruction_code = compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), 'reviewed-column-reconstruction', 'exec')

        # Preserve both historical-selector fixture failures; neither was a native schedule failure.
        failures = {
            'gates-public-source-suite': [
                'fe::routing_remaining::integration_tests::real_fast_and_low_callers_preserve_uncalibrated_arithmetic',
                'fe::routing_remaining::integration_tests::real_session_remaining_shell_has_an_exact_parent_admission_boundary'],
            'gates-public-source-suite-repaired': [
                'direct_full_rhs_admission_and_low_chunks_match_dense_qr_with_saved_gauge'],
        }
        checks = []
        for label, expected_exit in [('gates-public-source-suite', 101),
                                     ('gates-public-source-suite-repaired', 101),
                                     ('gates-public-historical-fixtures', 0),
                                     ('gates-public-direct-oracle', 0),
                                     ('gates-public-source-suite-final', 0)]:
            path = TASK / 'setup1-review/checks' / (label + '.json')
            record = read(path)
            verify(path.with_suffix('.log'), record['log_sha256'])
            require(record['exit'] == expected_exit, 'unexpected source-check disposition: ' + label)
            entry = {key: record[key] for key in ['label', 'command', 'exit', 'elapsed_s', 'log_sha256']}
            if label in failures:
                names = re.findall(r'^test (\S+) \.\.\. FAILED$', path.with_suffix('.log').read_text(), re.M)
                require(sorted(names) == sorted(failures[label]), 'retained source-suite failure set changed')
                entry['failed_test_names'] = names
                entry['classification'] = 'Retained stale historical-selector assumptions after public activation; source/test failure, not native scientific failure.'
            if label == 'gates-public-source-suite-repaired':
                require(record['log_sha256'] == '24a65965779c3d0f613a37de01e3ce1d1c1efeacf952c973b4461b2e2ff85929',
                        'second retained source-suite failure log changed')
            checks.append(entry)
        result['source_checks'] = checks

        def check_record(label):
            path = TASK / 'setup1-review/checks' / (label + '.json')
            record = read(path)
            verify(path.with_suffix('.log'), record['log_sha256'])
            require(record['exit'] == 0, 'failed prerequisite: ' + label)
            return {key: record[key] for key in ['label', 'command', 'exit', 'elapsed_s', 'log_sha256']}

        def successful_accounting(path, submit_label):
            verify(path)
            fields = {}
            for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
                pair = line.split(None, 1)
                if len(pair) == 2:
                    require(pair[0] not in fields, 'duplicate accounting field')
                    fields[pair[0]] = pair[1].strip()
            receipt = read(TASK / 'setup1-review/checks' / (submit_label + '.log'))
            require(fields['jobnumber'] == receipt['accepted_qsub_response']
                    and fields['taskid'] in {'undefined', '0'} and fields['failed'] == '0'
                    and fields['exit_status'] == '0' and fields['project'] == 'welfgr'
                    and fields['slots'] == '4', 'accounting identity/status mismatch')
            return fields

        def build_log_evidence(log_path, platform, artifact):
            verify(log_path)
            text = log_path.read_text()
            require(text.count('GATES_PUBLIC_' + ('MAC' if platform == 'Darwin' else 'LINUX') + '_BUILD_COMPLETE') == 1,
                    'missing actual build completion')
            require(text.count('actual-plugin ABI/self-test harness: PASS') == 1,
                    'missing actual load/ABI/panic-boundary completion')
            require(re.search(r'^' + sha(artifact) + r'\s+.*gates-public\.plugin\s*$', text, re.M),
                    'build log does not bind actual public binary')
            decoder = json.JSONDecoder(); audits = []
            for match in re.finditer(r'^\{', text, re.M):
                try:
                    value, _ = decoder.raw_decode(text[match.start():])
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('audit_passed') is True:
                    audits.append(value)
            require(len(audits) == 1 and audits[0]['size'] == artifact.stat().st_size
                    and audits[0]['format'] == ('macho' if platform == 'Darwin' else 'elf'), 'actual binary audit mismatch')
            # The bound loader source gates its single PASS marker on check_panic_boundary;
            # there is no separate success marker for this deliberately injected panic.
            loader = (source_root / 'tests/mock_spi/actual_plugin_loader_test.c').read_text()
            require('result = check_panic_boundary(call);' in loader, 'loader panic guard missing')
            return {'log_sha256':verify(log_path), 'audit_format':audits[0]['format'],
                    'binary_size':audits[0]['size'], 'actual_abi_load_and_panic_boundary':'passed',
                    'panic_evidence':'The source-bound actual loader PASS is emitted only after its panic-boundary check succeeds.'}

        build_checks = {'Darwin':check_record('gates-public-mac-build')}
        for label in ['gates-public-linux-build-submit', 'gates-public-linux-build-collect',
                      'gates-public-linux-check-submit', 'gates-public-linux-check-collect']:
            build_checks[label] = check_record(label)
        linux_native = WORK / 'activation-native-Linux'
        build_accounting = successful_accounting(linux_native / 'accounting.txt', 'gates-public-linux-build-submit')
        native_accounting = successful_accounting(linux_native / 'check-accounting.txt', 'gates-public-linux-check-submit')
        verify(linux_native / 'check-job.log')
        require((linux_native / 'check-job.log').read_text().count('GATES_PUBLIC_HIDDEN_EXACT_COMPLETE 126') == 1,
                'Linux correctness completion marker missing')
        result['native_build_checks'] = {'checks':build_checks, 'Linux_build_accounting':build_accounting,
                                        'Linux_correctness_accounting':native_accounting}

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='gates-public-review-') as scratch:
            temp = Path(scratch)
            for platform in ['Darwin', 'Linux']:
                config_path = WORK / ('activation-' + platform + '.json')
                config = read(config_path)
                require(clean(config) == freeze['configurations'][platform], 'configuration differs from activation freeze')
                require(config['platform'] == platform and config['call_cap'] == 126
                        and config['budget_s'] == 1800 and config['per_call_s'] == 120, 'changed schedule/budget')
                require(config['public_source_revision'] == source['fereg'] and config['execution_sources'] == execution,
                        'runtime/execution source binding differs')
                require(config['driver_sha256'] == freeze['driver']['sha256'], 'driver mismatch')
                plan_path = WORK / ('qualification-plan-Darwin.json' if platform == 'Darwin' else 'qualification-plan-Linux-mpi.json')
                plan = read(plan_path, config['qualification_plan_sha256'])
                require(len(plan['cases']) == 21 and plan['threads'] == [1, 4], 'qualification input scope changed')
                require(plan['artifacts']['candidate']['request'] == routing.GATES
                        and plan['artifacts']['candidate']['revision'] == 'e9be9e64e4c0d3bed2de5434e756246eee9296c1',
                        'wrong qualified hidden invocation')
                for relative, digest in plan['files'].items():
                    verify(q.resolve(plan_path, relative), digest)
                hidden = TASK / 'artifacts' / platform / 'policy-gates.plugin'
                public = TASK / 'artifacts' / platform / 'gates-public.plugin'
                verify(hidden, config['hidden_sha256']); verify(public, config['public_sha256'])
                build_log = (TASK / 'setup1-review/checks/gates-public-mac-build.log' if platform == 'Darwin'
                             else linux_native / 'job.log')
                build_evidence = build_log_evidence(build_log, platform, public)
                require(config['hidden_sha256'] == plan['files'][plan['artifacts']['candidate']['path']], 'wrong hidden binary')
                directory = WORK / ('activation-' + platform)
                summary_path = directory / 'summary.json'
                summary = read(summary_path)
                require(summary['config'] == config and summary['platform'] == platform and summary['status'] == 'passed'
                        and summary['failures'] == [] and summary['native_calls'] == 126
                        and summary['call_cap'] == 126 and summary['per_call_timeout_s'] == 120
                        and summary['total_budget_s'] == 1800 and 0 < summary['elapsed_s'] < 1800,
                        'incomplete/failed/unbounded activation schedule')
                if platform == 'Linux':
                    require(q.physical_host(summary['hostname'], True) == q.physical_host(native_accounting['hostname'], True),
                            'Linux correctness accounting host differs')
                mapped_identities = {}
                for name, digest in summary['identities'].items():
                    path = local_path(name).resolve()
                    require(path not in mapped_identities, 'duplicate mapped identity')
                    mapped_identities[path] = verify(path, digest)
                required_paths = [config_path, plan_path, hidden, public, q.resolve(plan_path, plan['harness']), TASK/'check-gates-public.py']
                required_paths += [q.resolve(plan_path, name) for name in plan['files']]
                # Mac executes repository modules; Linux executes the exact archived copies.
                for name, path in q.execution_sources().items():
                    relative = Path(path).resolve().relative_to(source_root.resolve())
                    executed = (REPO if platform == 'Darwin' else source_root) / relative
                    required_paths.append(executed)
                require(all(Path(p).resolve() in mapped_identities for p in required_paths), 'missing executed file identities')
                expected_cells = [f"{item['id']}-t{w}" for item in plan['cases'] for w in [1, 4]]
                require([c['id'] for c in summary['cells']] == expected_cells, 'missing/reordered/duplicate cells')
                expected_calls = [(cell, role) for cell in expected_cells for role in ['hidden', 'public', 'repeat']]
                require([(c['cell'], c['role']) for c in summary['calls']] == expected_calls, 'native calls were retried/reordered/omitted')
                qualified = {}
                if platform == 'Darwin':
                    binding = config['qualified_reference']
                    qp = TASK / binding['path']
                    old = read(qp, binding['sha256'])
                    require(old['status'] == 'complete' and not old['failures'] and old['manifest_sha256'] == routing.identity(plan),
                            'invalid qualified Mac reference')
                    require(q.physical_host(old['hostname'], True) == q.physical_host(summary['hostname'], True), 'Mac qualification host differs')
                    qualified = {c['id']: c for c in old['cases']}
                    require(set(qualified) == set(expected_cells), 'Mac reference cell scope differs')
                else:
                    require(config['qualified_reference'] is None and config['fresh_same_host_hidden_schedule'] is True,
                            'Linux substituted cross-processor exact reference')
                scope = {'hashlib': hashlib, 'json': json, 'q': q, 'np': np, 'manifest_path': plan_path, 'temp': temp, 'inputs': {}}
                exec(reconstruction_code, scope)
                first, public_rows = {}, []
                for index, cell in enumerate(summary['cells']):
                    item = plan['cases'][index // 2]; workers = [1, 4][index % 2]
                    meta = q.metadata(plan, item, plan_path)
                    policy = q.resource_policy(plan, 'candidate', meta)
                    folder = directory / cell['id']; base = folder / 'public-saved'
                    verify(base.with_suffix('.npz'), cell['retained_outputs_sha256'])
                    saved_head = read(base.with_suffix('.json'))
                    q.validate_result(saved_head)
                    columns = scope['reconstruct'](base, item['id'], item, meta, 'public')
                    columns_hash = sha(columns)
                    full = routing.identity({**q.exact_view(saved_head, False), 'columns_sha256': columns_hash})
                    require(cell['exact_public_hidden'] is True and cell['repeat'] is True and cell['independent_oracles'] == 3
                            and cell['cross_worker'] == ('reference' if workers == 1 else 'passed'), 'cell checks incomplete')
                    rows = summary['calls'][3*index:3*index+3]
                    stable_resources = []
                    for call in rows:
                        role = call['role']
                        require(call['status'] == 'passed' and call['oracle'] == 'passed', 'failed native call retained as passed')
                        raw = read(folder / (role + '.json'), call['result_sha256'])
                        require(raw.pop('columns') == [], 'unexpected inline native columns')
                        q.validate_result(raw)
                        if role == 'public':
                            require(raw == saved_head, 'public saved head differs from native head')
                        require(q.exact_view(raw, False) == q.exact_view(saved_head, False), 'fixed-worker scientific head changed')
                        require(call['columns_sha256'] == columns_hash and call['fingerprint'] == full, 'full scientific fingerprint changed')
                        require(q.worker_signature(raw) == call['worker_signature'], 'discrete signature changed')
                        log_path = folder / (role + '.log'); verify(log_path, call['log_sha256']); log = log_path.read_text()
                        timers = re.findall(r'^NATIVE_SECONDS=([0-9.]+)$', log, re.M)
                        require(len(timers) == 1 and math.isfinite(float(timers[0])) and 0 < float(timers[0]) <= 120
                                and float(timers[0]) == call['native_seconds'], 'native timer/call budget mismatch')
                        resources = q.science.resource_diagnostics(log, policy, False, {},
                            expected_preset=routing.policy(policy)['injection'] if policy else None)
                        resources['gate_events'] = gates.gate_events(log)
                        require(resources == call['resource'] and gates.semantic_signature(resources) == call['policy_signature'],
                                'resource/gate/hierarchy attestation differs')
                        stable_resources.append({key: ([{k:v for k,v in a.items() if k != 'memory_bytes_limit'} for a in value]
                                                if key == 'action_resources' else value) for key,value in resources.items()})
                        request = temp / ('hidden.case' if role == 'hidden' else 'public.case')
                        if role != 'repeat':
                            routing.prepare(q.resolve(plan_path,item['input']), request, routing.GATES if role=='hidden' else 'baseline', workers)
                        require(sha(request) == call['input_sha256'], 'prepared input bytes differ')
                        q.science.check_oracle(raw, columns, meta)
                        counts['oracle_head_checks'] += 1; counts['raw_logs_heads'] += 1; counts['calls'] += 1
                    require(stable_resources[0] == stable_resources[1] == stable_resources[2], 'public/hidden resource accounting changed')
                    require(len({r['worker_signature'] for r in rows}) == 1 and len({r['policy_signature'] for r in rows}) == 1,
                            'public/hidden/repeat discrete policy changed')
                    if qualified:
                        old = qualified[cell['id']]; warm = next(c for c in old['warmups'] if c['execution']=='candidate')
                        require(rows[0]['fingerprint'] == warm['fingerprint']
                                and rows[0]['worker_signature'] == old['worker_signatures']['candidate'], 'qualified hidden changed on Mac')
                        # Verify the original qualified head/array bindings; compare retained public columns scientifically too.
                        oldbase = (TASK/config['qualified_reference']['path']).parent / old['references']['candidate']
                        verify(oldbase.with_suffix('.json'), old['reference_files']['candidate']['head'])
                        verify(oldbase.with_suffix('.npz'), old['reference_files']['candidate']['outputs'])
                        q.compare_saved(oldbase, base, meta); counts['qualified_reference_checks'] += 1
                    if workers == 1:
                        first[item['id']] = (base, rows[1])
                    else:
                        before, before_call = first[item['id']]
                        q.compare_saved(before, base, meta)
                        require(before_call['worker_signature'] == rows[1]['worker_signature']
                                and before_call['policy_signature'] == rows[1]['policy_signature'], 'cross-worker decisions changed')
                        counts['cross_worker_checks'] += 1
                    counts['public_npz_banks'] += 1; counts['cells'] += 1
                    public_rows.append({'cell':cell['id'], 'fingerprint':full, 'columns_sha256':columns_hash,
                                        'worker_signature':rows[1]['worker_signature'], 'policy_signature':rows[1]['policy_signature']})
                platforms[platform] = {'summary_sha256':verify(summary_path), 'config_sha256':verify(config_path),
                    'public_sha256':config['public_sha256'], 'hidden_sha256':config['hidden_sha256'],
                    'hostname':summary['hostname'], 'native_calls':126, 'cells':42, 'elapsed_s':summary['elapsed_s'],
                    'public_fingerprints':public_rows, 'native_build':build_evidence, 'status':'passed'}
            require(counts['calls'] == 252 and counts['cells'] == 84 and counts['public_npz_banks'] == 84
                    and counts['cross_worker_checks'] == 42 and counts['qualified_reference_checks'] == 42,
                    'incomplete combined activation evidence')
        require(all(q.stamp(path) == stamp for path,stamp in stamps.items()), 'bound evidence drifted during analysis')
        require(time.monotonic() - start < 600, 'analysis budget exhausted before publication')
        result.update(status='passed', platforms=platforms)
    except BaseException as error:
        result['status'] = 'failed'; result['errors'].append({'type':type(error).__name__, 'message':str(error)})
    finally:
        result['elapsed_s'] = time.monotonic() - start
        result['counts'] = dict(counts)
        named = {str(path): digest for path,digest in bindings.items()}
        result['bindings'] = {'files':len(named), 'canonical_sha256':identity(named), 'sha256':clean(named)}
        data = json.dumps(clean(result),sort_keys=True,separators=(',', ':'),allow_nan=False) + '\n'
        require(len(data.encode()) < 1_000_000, 'independent review exceeds compact output limit')
        with OUTPUT.open('x') as stream:
            stream.write(data)
        signal.alarm(0)
    print(json.dumps({'status':result['status'], 'counts':dict(counts), 'errors':result['errors']}))
    return 0 if result['status']=='passed' else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Execute the real driver with retained outputs and zero native calls."""
import ast
import contextlib
import copy
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import runpy
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile

task=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=task.parents[2]
sys.path[:0]=[str(repo/'bench'),str(repo/'scripts')]
import numpy as np
import qualify as q
import routing

plan_path=task/'policy-gates/qualification-plan-Darwin.json'
plan=q.read(plan_path)
run=task/'policy-gates/qualification-Darwin/run-0-0'
reference=q.read(run/'results.json')
cells={c['id']:c for c in reference['cases']}
items={c['id']:c for c in plan['cases']}
nodes=[n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse((task/'verify-gates-qualification-linux.py').read_text()))
       if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in {'require','identity','original_bank','reconstruct'}]
assert len(nodes)==4
driver=task/'check-gates-public.py'
real_runner=q.run_process
results=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='activation-preflight-',dir=task) as directory:
    root=Path(directory)
    banks=root/'banks';banks.mkdir()
    scope={'hashlib':hashlib,'json':json,'q':q,'np':np,'manifest_path':plan_path,'temp':banks,'inputs':{}}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),'verifier-reconstruction','exec'),scope)
    paths={name:str(q.resolve(plan_path,name)) for name in plan['files']}
    def absolute(x):
        if isinstance(x,str):return paths.get(x,x)
        if isinstance(x,list):return [absolute(v) for v in x]
        if isinstance(x,dict):return {paths.get(k,k):absolute(v) for k,v in x.items()}
        return x
    relocated=absolute(plan)
    for scenario in ['complete','output_bit','memory_overrun','native_failure','wrong_hidden_binding']:
        case=root/scenario;work=case/'policy-gates';work.mkdir(parents=True)
        artifacts=case/'artifacts/Darwin';artifacts.mkdir(parents=True)
        hidden=task/'artifacts/Darwin/policy-gates.plugin'
        for name in ['policy-gates.plugin','gates-public.plugin']:(artifacts/name).symlink_to(hidden)
        source=case/driver.name;shutil.copyfile(driver,source)
        q.write(work/'qualification-plan-Darwin.json',relocated)
        ref=copy.deepcopy(reference);ref['manifest_sha256']=routing.identity(relocated)
        q.write(work/'reference.json',ref)
        config={'call_cap':126,'budget_s':1800,'per_call_s':120,'driver_sha256':q.digest(source),
            'qualification_plan_sha256':q.digest(work/'qualification-plan-Darwin.json'),
            'hidden_sha256':q.digest(hidden),'public_sha256':q.digest(hidden),
            'execution_sources':{n:q.digest(p) for n,p in q.execution_sources().items()},
            'qualified_reference':{'path':'policy-gates/reference.json','sha256':q.digest(work/'reference.json')}}
        if scenario=='wrong_hidden_binding':config['hidden_sha256']='0'*64
        config_path=work/'activation-Darwin.json';q.write(config_path,config)
        executed=[]
        def replay(command,log,timeout):
            assert '--replay' in command and 0<timeout<=120
            target=Path(command[-1]);cell=target.parent.name;role=target.stem
            executed.append((cell,role))
            if scenario=='native_failure':raise RuntimeError('synthetic native failure')
            old=cells[cell];key=cell.rsplit('-t',1)[0];item=items[key];meta=q.metadata(plan,item,plan_path)
            base=run/old['references']['candidate']
            shutil.copyfile(base.parent/'warmup-candidate.json',target)
            logtext=(base.parent/'warmup-candidate.log').read_text()
            # Different observed limits must survive exact comparisons, but caps
            # still apply independently to every action.
            logtext=re.sub(r'(?<=\|memory_limit=)\d+',lambda m:str(int(m[0])+len(executed)),logtext)
            if scenario=='memory_overrun':
                logtext=re.sub(r'(?<=\|memory_limit=)\d+','0',logtext)
            log.write_text(logtext)
            reconstructed=scope['reconstruct'](base,key,item,meta,'preflight')
            columns=target.with_suffix('.json.columns');shutil.copyfile(reconstructed,columns)
            if scenario=='output_bit' and role=='public':
                data=np.memmap(columns,dtype=np.uint64,mode='r+',shape=(meta['columns'],meta['rows']))
                data[meta['outputs']['residual'],0]^=np.uint64(1);data.flush();del data
        q.run_process=replay
        saved_argv=sys.argv;sys.argv=[str(source),q.digest(config_path)]
        error=None
        try:
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):runpy.run_path(str(source),run_name='__main__')
        except BaseException as caught:error=caught
        finally:sys.argv=saved_argv;q.run_process=real_runner
        summary=work/'activation-Darwin/summary.json'
        if scenario=='complete':
            assert error is None,error
            value=q.read(summary);assert value['status']=='passed' and len(executed)==126
            assert len(value['cells'])==42 and all(c['status']=='passed' for c in value['calls'])
        elif scenario=='wrong_hidden_binding':
            assert isinstance(error,AssertionError) and not executed and not summary.exists()
        else:
            assert error is not None
            value=q.read(summary);assert value['status']=='failed'
            assert value['native_calls']==len(executed) and len(executed)<126
            last=value['calls'][-1]
            assert (summary.parent/last['cell']/(last['role']+'.case')).exists()
        results.append({'scenario':scenario,'synthetic_calls':len(executed),'status':'passed',
                        'observed_error':None if error is None else str(error)})
        shutil.rmtree(case)
print(json.dumps({'native_calls':0,'driver_sha256':q.digest(driver),'checks':results}))
